answer: Each identity binds one licensed tower-crane operator certificate, registry-checked, tied to one operator by exam and lifts. Earning it takes a twelve-week course, 500 supervised lifts and a summit-cab test. The kernel is the site-signed lift log, each entry cipher-sealed to the certificate; one certificate backs one identity. Each fake costs 2,400 units and 120 days; 100 fakes cost 240,000 units and 12,000 days. Cheapest cheat: hire a licensed operator to lift under another name; they surrender their own certificate, and a forged log fails the cipher seal and site audit.
